title: Decoded Quantum Interferometry Beyond Hamming: Rank-Metric and Translation Association Schemes
summary: Decoded Quantum Interferometry (DQI) uses coherent decoding and a quantum Fourier transform to find high-quality solutions of structured optimisation problems. Existing analyses are closely tied to Hamming space, which underlies the optimisation objective, Dicke state preparation and the decoding step of the algorithm. Here we extend the core DQI mechanism beyond Hamming space to finite geometries with translation symmetry, where points are grouped into shells by their distance from a basepoint.
